name: Trace Removal Attempt
description: This rule detects attempts to erase evidence of malicious activity by targeting system logs, shell history, or temporary artifacts. It also covers actions that attempt to disable or tamper with logging mechanisms like rsyslog or systemd-journald. These actions are frequently used by attackers to evade detection and hinder forensic investigations.
note:
- Confirm if the deleted file was a log, shell history, or temporary malware artifact.
- Check the user, terminal session, and parent process of the deleting command.
- Correlate with earlier suspicious activity (e.g., shell access, privilege escalation).
- Investigate if rsyslog, systemd-journald, or other loggers were tampered with.
- If available, pull logs from centralized log collectors (SIEM, remote syslog).
false_positives: System maintenance or log rotation scripts may exhibit similar behavior.
Verify if the deletion aligns with scheduled log management procedures.
Whitelist known-good cleanup tools (e.g., logrotate, tmpwatch) where needed.
query:
event.dataset: "auditd.log" and
auditd.log.record_type: "EXECVE" and
(
  (
    process.executable: "rm" or
    process.executable: "truncate" or
    process.executable: "unlink" or
    process.executable: "shred" or
    process.executable: "dd"
  )
  and (
    process.args: *bash_history* or
    process.args: *auth.log* or
    process.args: *wtmp* or
    process.args: *btmp* or
    process.args: *secure* or
    process.args: *messages* or
    process.args: *syslog* or
    process.args: *.log* or
    process.args: *journal* or
    process.args: "/tmp" or
    process.args: "/var/tmp" or
    process.args: "/dev/shm" or
    process.args: "/home/*/.bash_history"
  )
and not process.args: *clamscan*
  and not process.args: *clamscan_hourly*
  and not process.args: *clamav*
and not process.args: */var/crash/*
  and not process.args: *.crash*
)
or
(
  (process.executable: "systemctl" or process.executable: "service")
  and (process.args: *stop* or process.args: *disable*)
  and (process.args: *rsyslog* or process.args: *systemd-journald* or process.args: *auditd*)
)
or
(
  (process.executable: "kill" or process.executable: "pkill" or process.executable: "killall")
  and (process.args: *rsyslog* or process.args: *systemd-journald* or process.args: *auditd*)
)
or
(
  (process.executable: "echo" or process.executable: "tee" or process.executable: "dd")
  and (
    process.args: *bash_history* or
    process.args: *auth.log* or
    process.args: *secure* or
    process.args: *wtmp* or
    process.args: *btmp* or
    process.args: *syslog* or
    process.args: *messages* or
    process.args: *.log* or
    process.args: "/tmp" or
    process.args: "/var/tmp" or
    process.args: "/dev/shm"
  )
  and (
    process.args: ">*" or process.args: ">>*" or process.args: */dev/null*
  )
  and not process.args: *clamav*
  and not process.args: *clamscan*
  and not process.args: *clamscan_hourly*
and not process.args: */var/crash/*
  and not process.args: *.crash*
)
and not user.name: "root"
and not process.executable: "cat"
